added_lines: 2nd APRIL 2017 – 5th SUNDAY OF LENT Thought for the Week “Make sure that every person, of whatever background, will find in you a welcoming heart.” Pope Benedict XVI PRAYER OF THE DAY Lord Jesus Christ, in you we see the splendour of God in human form, sharing our joys, sufferings and frailty. In your resurrection and ascension, we see your divinity completed and we are silenced in wonder. May we find in your service true freedom and in your will our hopes fulfilled. St. Patrick’s Girl Guide Unit would like to express our sincere appreciation to everyone wh o joined us for our Celebration Mass on Sunday, 18th October.
A special word of thanks to Fr Declan for celebrating the Mass, and to Catherine and Angela for their help, support and dedication in preparing for the service.

We would also like to thank our wonderful community for re turning to the community centre and sharing in this special occasion with us as we celebrated 10 years of Girl Guiding in Aghagallon . It was lovely to come together, reflect on our journey so far and celebrate this important milestone.

Shoebox Appeal – Romania: One of the Day Centres who told us they were sourcing presents locally this year changed their minds a nd have asked us for help.
In addition to the 100 shoeboxes for adult males already requested, we now need an extra: 10 boxes for girls (aged under 10), 10 boxes for boys (aged under 12) 30 boxes for women , 50 boxes for men.

Please pick up one of the information leaflets in the porch which are now marked adult male/female or young girl/boy to ensure we only send what is needed, and return your shoebox to the porch of St Patrick’s Church, Aghagallon before
Monday 16th November 2026. If you would prefer to make a cash donation to support the pr ojects, envelopes are available in the porch.
Sleeping Bag Appeal: We are collecting sleeping bags for the Capuchin Day Centre for Homeless People in Dublin.
If you want to donate a sleeping bag, please leave it in the church porch no later than
Monday 16th November 2026. If you would like to donate £5 towards the cost of a sleeping bag, please put it in the envelopes provided and leave in the collection basket during Mass.
Annual Mass for the Dead:
Thursday 19th November 2026 at 7pm. During the Mass we will pray for loved ones who have died during the past year.
Family members will be invited to remember each person in a special way.
Refreshments will be available afterwards in the Community Centre.
Aghagallon Preschool’s Christmas Experience :
Sunday 6th December 2pm – 6pm. Riverdale Barn, Aghagallon. £5 entry per person and under 1 free.
Saturday evening Choir: The Choir urgently needs new members of all ages.
If you enjoy singing and would like to be part of this very special ministry, please speak to Chris after Mass.

Booking Masses, Baptisms and Weddings As parish office opening hours have been reduced slightly, we are returning to our previous practice of booking Masses, baptis ms and weddings in person, in the sacristy after Masses.
